jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
💈 
WHO WE ARE

SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue.

Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs.

For more information, please visit getsquire.com or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store.

🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

At SQUIRE, trusted data turns information into action - powering everything from company-wide reporting and automation to the AI capabilities shaping our next chapter. We're hiring a Director, Data Engineering
to build and lead our Data organization through a player-coach model, spending approximately half your time hands-on in the code and the other half developing engineers, setting technical direction, and owning the organization’s strategy. You’ll own SQUIRE’s long-term data architecture and lead a growing team spanning Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Analytics.

Success in this role means building a data foundation the company trusts by default, with reliable pipelines, clear standards, and scalable systems. You'll have the authority and accountability to make architectural and organizational decisions needed to move the function forward while helping the team grow in both capability and impact. As SQUIRE continues to scale, your work will directly enable more confident decision-making, stronger automation, and AI use cases that power our next phase of growth.

Reports To
: Chief Product and Technology Officer
Location
: Remote - US or Canada
Type
: Full-Time
Compensation
: Base ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)

🧰 YOUR CRAFT (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

Design, build, and debug the highest-impact pipelines, connecting our business systems, including CRM, billing, and internal platforms to our Snowflake warehouse, in both directions

Own the data strategy and architecture across a multi-year horizon, while maintaining deep, hands-on familiarity with the systems and their edge cases

Establish technical direction and standards for pipeline design, data modeling, and data quality across the org; personally build and ship the highest-risk or most ambiguous work

Build, structure, and lead a growing Data organization of 5+ across Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and Analytics

Own headcount planning, hiring strategy, and budget for the Data organization

Partner with the Chief Product and Technology Officer and cross-functional leaders to translate company strategy into data contracts and platform investments

Lead audits of existing integrations and automations, and determine what should be replaced and how that work should be prioritized

Champion AI and automation enablement company-wide, ensuring agents and LLM use cases are built on a trusted data foundation, while remaining hands-on in building select enablement capabilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time based on business needs.

⚙️ YOUR FOUNDATION (Experience & Skills)

8+ years in data or software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers

Experience building and leading a multidisciplinary data organization (data, ML, analytics, software) of 5+ people

Advanced SQL and Python skills, along with strong MDM fundamentals, with the technical depth to lead by example

Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent), dbt, and an orchestration tool such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, beyond just an architectural understanding

Direct experience setting AI and LLM enablement strategy and building with LLM tooling

Comfortable operating at Director scope ( owning budgets, advocating for roadmaps, and translating technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders ) while remaining directly involved in technical execution

✂️ EXTRA CUT (Nice to Haves)

Experience building AI agents with LLMs ( wired models into real systems with tool use, retrieval, and orchestration ) and with the ability to guide others doing similar work

Backend engineering experience (ideally in JS/TS) with sufficient depth to effectively evaluate architecture

Strong ML and MLOps knowledge, with the ability to set direction, assess technical tradeoffs, and support ML Engineering Leads

Experience with Salesforce, Stripe, Gong, or reverse ETL (Polytomic), and data governance / PII handling at a company-wide policy level

Don’t let this list stop you from applying - If you are interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you!

🚀 WHY SQUIRE?
As a Director, Data Engineering, you’ll have real ownership over a function the whole company depends on, a mandate to develop its leadership structure, and the charter to define the data foundation for SQUIRE's AI future — with the authority to turn that strategy into a lasting practice.

🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

Base Salary ($200,000 - $230,000) +  Bonus (15%)

New hire stock grant

100% employer-paid medical/dental/vision insurance for you and your dependents

401K plan with company contribution

Generous PTO and Parental Leave policies

Interview Accommodations

SQUIRE is committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to recruiting@getsquire.com and someone on our team will respond to your request.

Equal Employment Opportunity

SQUIRE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

SQUIRE will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
Woodward is committed to creating a great workplace for all team members. Our company and its members are committed to acting with integrity, being respectful and accountable to one another, and staying humble and driven, while maintaining the highest professional and ethical standards.

We are steadfastly committed to attracting the best talent across our communities, creating a rewarding workplace. Together we are fulfilling our purpose to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future.

Woodward supports our members’ wellbeing and regularly benchmarks with other companies in our industry to offer an extensive Total Reward package for this position.
Salary will be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Senior Manager, Engineering

Woodward’s Industrial product division in Fort Collins, Colorado is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Engineering Manager
to lead our engineering teams and drive continuous improvement in product development. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence. Candidates with a strong Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering background with strong machining knowledge are highly encouraged to apply.

Estimated annual base pay: $145,000-$190,000

All members included in annual cash bonus opportunity.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive Continuous Improvement: Work with leaders and senior engineers to implement and support systemic and process improvements to enhance product development velocity, ensure robust design culture, and pursue better ways of working through learning, adapting, and driving measurable progress.
Go and See Leadership: Actively engage with teams by showing up where the work happens, listening deeply, and understanding team needs to provide effective support.
Coach and Mentor Staff Leaders and Senior Engineers: Build trust, empower team members, and provide feedback to grow individuals to their full potential while maintaining a highly skilled and adaptable team using talent management systems, training matrices, and performance reviews.
Develop and Maintain Design Standards: Create, maintain, and improve design standards to ensure high-quality, compliant products while leveraging lessons learned to enhance future designs.
Budget and Resource Management: Develop and manage budgets to align with profit planning activities, assign resources effectively to meet business needs, and achieve the company’s profitability objectives.

Key Skills:

Leadership and People Management: Strong leadership and motivational skills to coach, mentor, and empower leaders and senior engineers while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Ability to adapt to changing environments, maintain a customer-focused mindset, and learn quickly to address emerging challenges.
Technical Expertise: Proficiency in tools like CAD systems, CAE systems, design evaluation matrices, DFMEA, GD&T, configuration management, ECR management, and test methods.
Continuous Improvement Knowledge: Expertise in Design for Six Sigma, lean product development, waste elimination, and structured problem-solving methods.
Communication and Presentation Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly and effectively.
Product Life Cycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of the product life cycle, including key deliverables and integration of lessons learned into future designs.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to align technical direction with corporate strategic goals, execute effectively, and drive meaningful progress.
Risk Management: Superb skills in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating risks to ensure robust product designs.
Training and Development: Skilled in creating training programs and maintaining training matrices to upskill staff to meet organizational needs.
Financial Analysis and Budgeting: Strong understanding of financial analysis tools and the ability to manage budgets effectively to meet objectives.

Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Have:

Strong Machining Experience
Metal Removal Exprerience
Experience leading and mentoring teams of engineers

About The Department

George Mason University has experienced rapid growth over the past several years, resulting in R1 classification, a significant increase in invention disclosures, and a growing portfolio of maturing technologies. With the continued expansion of the regional innovation ecosystem and numerous technology-driven companies in Northern Virginia, the University is advancing its technology transfer and commercialization infrastructure.

The Office of Technology Transfer sits in Mason Enterprise, part of the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact, which leads university-wide efforts related to innovation, commercialization, entrepreneurship, and industry engagement. The University continues to build a more holistic innovation and business development function to better serve faculty and student innovators, deepen industry partnerships, and contribute to the region’s entrepreneurial ecosystem.

About The Position

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer supports the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact's growth. This position reflects a refined, execution-focused leadership model while maintaining strategic responsibility for technology transfer across the University. The Senior Director will play a critical role in translating George Mason’s research discoveries into societal and economic impact through intellectual property protection, commercialization, industry engagement, and startup support. This position fits within George Mason’s highly collaborative and inclusive culture and strongly supports the University’s commitment to research commercialization and entrepreneurship.

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer leads the University’s efforts to facilitate the transfer of research discoveries and innovations for public use and benefit. The Senior Director establishes and implements strategies, tools, and procedures to evaluate, protect, market, and commercialize technologies developed by faculty and students. The position has responsibility for technology transfer across all George Mason University campuses.

This role requires independent decision-making authority that substantially affects business operations. The Senior Director reports to the Associate Vice President for Innovation and Economic Development and works closely with faculty, university leadership, legal counsel, industry partners, investors, and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Technology Transfer & Intellectual Property Management:

Lead and oversee the assessment, protection, and management of intellectual property, including inventions, software, data, and other research outputs;
Guide patenting and IP strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel;
Oversee the evaluation of invention disclosures for commercial potential and prioritize technologies for investment and advancement;
Lead negotiation and execution of license agreements, option agreements, NDAs, MTAs, and other IP-related contracts; and
Assist the Office of Sponsored Programs and University Counsel with intellectual property clauses in university agreements.

Technology Transfer Operations, Strategy & Team Leadership

Coordinate with the Associate Vice President to lead operational functions and new initiatives aligned with university strategy;
Recommend and implement streamlined procedures, systems, and best practices for technology transfer operations;
Manage staff and build a high-performing team to support invention intake, IP management, licensing, and industry engagement;
Maintain and enhance reporting, project management, and database systems related to commercialization activities;
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and outside counsel; and
Assist the Vice President of Research with George Mason Research Foundation operations.

Compliance, Policy & Stakeholder Communication

Ensure compliance with federal regulations, including Bayh–Dole requirements, conflict-of-interest policies, and reporting obligations;
Communicate technology transfer policies and processes to faculty in a manner that fosters understanding, trust, and collaboration; and
Prepare and present reports to university leadership as required.

Industry Partnerships & Commercialization Strategy

Serve as a liaison between faculty and industry partners to identify and align industry-relevant research opportunities;
Cultivate and manage relationships with corporations, startups, investors, venture capital firms, accelerators, and government agencies; and
Promote George Mason technologies through targeted outreach, meetings, presentations, and strategic partnerships.

Entrepreneurship & Innovation Ecosystem Development

Support faculty and student entrepreneurs in navigating commercialization pathways;
Collaborate with campus entrepreneurship programs, incubators, and economic development organizations; and
Provide strategic guidance to university-affiliated startups and help reduce barriers to startup formation and growth.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering, and business or law, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience;
Significant experience (generally at least 10 years) in technology transfer, intellectual property management, licensing, business development, or a related field within a research-intensive environment;
Generally, at least 5 years of proven leadership and people management skills;
Knowledge of technology transfer, intellectual property management, licensing, business development, or a related field within a research-intensive environment;
Demonstrated skill and success negotiating complex contracts and managing patent expenses;
Strong understanding/knowledge of the university research environment and ability to translate between academic research and industry needs;
Demonstrated team leadership and people management skills;
Ability to translate complex technical research into clear, non-confidential technology descriptions;
Demonstrated strategic thinking, sound judgment, and ability to work independently in a collaborative environment;
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
Strong organizational abilities;
Proficiency with MS Office and CRM or database systems; and
Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

Terminal degree such as a J.D., Ph.D., or MBA;
Background in computing, cybersecurity, bio-technology, engineering or other high-growth technology domains;
Significant experience in an academic technology transfer or commercialization office, particularly at an R1 institution;
Experience negotiating early-stage technology intellectual property and licensing agreements for businesses;
Experience with startup formation, early-stage venture financing, and entrepreneurial ecosystems;
Experience managing outside patent counsel and converting invention disclosures into strong provisional applications;
Established relationships with industry, investors, or sponsors involved in research or commercialization;
Experience implementing operational systems in a technology transfer or innovation office; and
Familiarity with AUTM practices and federal technology transfer regulations.

Instructions To Applicants

For full consideration, applicants must apply for the Senior Director, Technology Transfer
at https://jobs.gmu.edu/. Complete and submit the online application to include three professional references with contact information, and provide a cover letter and resume for review.

Posting Open Date:
August 24, 2026

For Full Consideration, Apply by:
September 7, 2026

Open Until Filled:
Yes

Mason Ad Statement

George Mason University is a nationally ranked R1 research university committed to creating a more just, free, and prosperous world. With 40,000 enrolled students, George Mason is the largest and most diverse public research university in Virginia, offering degree programs at the master's, doctoral, and professional level, along with certificates and credentials.

George Mason fosters an All Together Different environment for students, faculty, and staff, driven by our core beliefs. We believe in inclusivity over exclusivity; we believe in advancing our mission by being willing to take risks, not avoiding them; and we believe our best work is possible when we apply our diversity of origin, identity, circumstance, and thought.

Equity Statement

George Mason University is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, committed to promoting inclusion and equity in its community. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

Job Description

This is a duration based role that will last 18 months.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personalized.

The Director, GCA Technology Lead, Strategy & Transformation is a strategic technology leader responsible for advancing Global Corporate Affairs technology strategy, AI readiness, Product Operating Model maturity, digital transformation, and knowledge management capabilities. This role will help shape the future of GCA by identifying and scaling innovative technologies, modernizing operating models, and delivering transformational business outcomes through AI-enabled products, platforms, and processes.

Reporting to the Product Group Leader, Global Corporate Affairs Technology, this leader will serve as the strategic connector among GCA business leaders, Corporate Business Technology, enterprise technology teams, and external partners. The role is accountable for defining and driving a transformation roadmap that enables GCA to operate as a modern, data-driven, AI-enabled organization.

The successful candidate will possess significant experience operating within a Product Operating Model environment and a demonstrated track record leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business value.

Responsibilities

Develop and execute a comprehensive GCA Technology Strategy and Transformation roadmap aligned to Global Corporate Affairs priorities and enterprise objectives.
Lead strategic technology assessments that modernize business processes, simplify technology ecosystems, and drive operational excellence.
Drive adoption and maturity of the Product Operating Model across GCA Technology, including roadmap planning, prioritization, governance, and value measurement.
Lead GCA’s AI readiness strategy, ensuring the organization develops the capabilities, governance, operating models, and skills required to scale AI responsibly.
Drive adoption of generative AI, agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, enterprise AI solutions, and emerging technologies across GCA.
Establish AI governance, value realization metrics, and adoption frameworks aligned with Johnson & Johnson standards.
Develop and lead enterprise knowledge and content management strategies that improve creation, discovery, reuse, lifecycle management, and retention.
Partner with Corporate Communications, Government Affairs, Media Relations, Brand, Technology, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Global Services teams to deliver transformational initiatives.
Oversee a portfolio of capabilities and products supporting AI, knowledge management, workflow automation, communications, digital experiences, and employee productivity.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Owners and technology professionals.
Build organizational capabilities that support AI fluency, Product Operating Model adoption, innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.
Measure success through business outcomes, OKRs, value realization, adoption, risk reduction, stakeholder satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree is required.
Minimum 10 years of experience in technology, strategy, digital transformation, product management, or related disciplines.
Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience leading technology, product, strategy, or transformation teams.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation programs that deliver measurable business value.
Proven experience working within a Product Operating Model environment.
Experience managing product portfolios, roadmaps, governance processes, OKRs, business cases, and value realization activities.
Practical experience applying generative AI, agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, and enterprise AI capabilities to improve products, processes, user experiences, and business outcomes.
Working knowledge of Responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, governance, data ethics, and compliant AI implementation.
Experience driving AI readiness, workforce fluency, organizational change management, and technology adoption programs.
Knowledge management, enterprise content management, workflow automation, data and analytics strategy, and risk/compliance management experience.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Communications, or a related discipline preferred.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product and Software Security
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide.

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio.

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.

What You'll Do

Define and Implement Security Strategy

Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems.
Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Engineering, Platform, and Security leaders, helping drive innovation, customer trust, and business growth.
Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security.

Drive Systemic Risk Reduction

Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices.
Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation.
Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture.

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era

Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms.
Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences.
Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale.

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization

Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams.
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Strengthen Customer Trust

Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle.
Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.
Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust.

What You'll Bring

Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies.
Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities.
Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.
Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services.

Leadership Characteristics

The successful candidate will:

Create the Future by enabling secure innovation and helping Adobe capitalize on emerging technologies.
Own the Outcome by driving meaningful improvements in security, trust, and organizational effectiveness.
Set a higher standard through technical excellence, operational rigor, and talent development.
Be Genuine by building trusted partnerships and leading with transparency and integrity.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. new_jobs.description:
💈 
WHO WE ARE

SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue.

Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs.

For more information, please visit getsquire.com or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store.

🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

At SQUIRE, trusted data turns information into action - powering everything from company-wide reporting and automation to the AI capabilities shaping our next chapter. We're hiring a Director, Data Engineering
to build and lead our Data organization through a player-coach model, spending approximately half your time hands-on in the code and the other half developing engineers, setting technical direction, and owning the organization’s strategy. You’ll own SQUIRE’s long-term data architecture and lead a growing team spanning Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Analytics.

Success in this role means building a data foundation the company trusts by default, with reliable pipelines, clear standards, and scalable systems. You'll have the authority and accountability to make architectural and organizational decisions needed to move the function forward while helping the team grow in both capability and impact. As SQUIRE continues to scale, your work will directly enable more confident decision-making, stronger automation, and AI use cases that power our next phase of growth.

Reports To
: Chief Product and Technology Officer
Location
: Remote - US or Canada
Type
: Full-Time
Compensation
: Base ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)

🧰 YOUR CRAFT (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

Design, build, and debug the highest-impact pipelines, connecting our business systems, including CRM, billing, and internal platforms to our Snowflake warehouse, in both directions

Own the data strategy and architecture across a multi-year horizon, while maintaining deep, hands-on familiarity with the systems and their edge cases

Establish technical direction and standards for pipeline design, data modeling, and data quality across the org; personally build and ship the highest-risk or most ambiguous work

Build, structure, and lead a growing Data organization of 5+ across Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and Analytics

Own headcount planning, hiring strategy, and budget for the Data organization

Partner with the Chief Product and Technology Officer and cross-functional leaders to translate company strategy into data contracts and platform investments

Lead audits of existing integrations and automations, and determine what should be replaced and how that work should be prioritized

Champion AI and automation enablement company-wide, ensuring agents and LLM use cases are built on a trusted data foundation, while remaining hands-on in building select enablement capabilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time based on business needs.

⚙️ YOUR FOUNDATION (Experience & Skills)

8+ years in data or software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers

Experience building and leading a multidisciplinary data organization (data, ML, analytics, software) of 5+ people

Advanced SQL and Python skills, along with strong MDM fundamentals, with the technical depth to lead by example

Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent), dbt, and an orchestration tool such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, beyond just an architectural understanding

Direct experience setting AI and LLM enablement strategy and building with LLM tooling

Comfortable operating at Director scope ( owning budgets, advocating for roadmaps, and translating technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders ) while remaining directly involved in technical execution

✂️ EXTRA CUT (Nice to Haves)

Experience building AI agents with LLMs ( wired models into real systems with tool use, retrieval, and orchestration ) and with the ability to guide others doing similar work

Backend engineering experience (ideally in JS/TS) with sufficient depth to effectively evaluate architecture

Strong ML and MLOps knowledge, with the ability to set direction, assess technical tradeoffs, and support ML Engineering Leads

Experience with Salesforce, Stripe, Gong, or reverse ETL (Polytomic), and data governance / PII handling at a company-wide policy level

Don’t let this list stop you from applying - If you are interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you!

🚀 WHY SQUIRE?
As a Director, Data Engineering, you’ll have real ownership over a function the whole company depends on, a mandate to develop its leadership structure, and the charter to define the data foundation for SQUIRE's AI future — with the authority to turn that strategy into a lasting practice.

About The Department

George Mason University has experienced rapid growth over the past several years, resulting in R1 classification, a significant increase in invention disclosures, and a growing portfolio of maturing technologies. With the continued expansion of the regional innovation ecosystem and numerous technology-driven companies in Northern Virginia, the University is advancing its technology transfer and commercialization infrastructure.

The Office of Technology Transfer sits in Mason Enterprise, part of the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact, which leads university-wide efforts related to innovation, commercialization, entrepreneurship, and industry engagement. The University continues to build a more holistic innovation and business development function to better serve faculty and student innovators, deepen industry partnerships, and contribute to the region’s entrepreneurial ecosystem.

About The Position

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer supports the Office of Research, Innovation, and Economic Impact's growth. This position reflects a refined, execution-focused leadership model while maintaining strategic responsibility for technology transfer across the University. The Senior Director will play a critical role in translating George Mason’s research discoveries into societal and economic impact through intellectual property protection, commercialization, industry engagement, and startup support. This position fits within George Mason’s highly collaborative and inclusive culture and strongly supports the University’s commitment to research commercialization and entrepreneurship.

The Senior Director, Technology Transfer leads the University’s efforts to facilitate the transfer of research discoveries and innovations for public use and benefit. The Senior Director establishes and implements strategies, tools, and procedures to evaluate, protect, market, and commercialize technologies developed by faculty and students. The position has responsibility for technology transfer across all George Mason University campuses.

This role requires independent decision-making authority that substantially affects business operations. The Senior Director reports to the Associate Vice President for Innovation and Economic Development and works closely with faculty, university leadership, legal counsel, industry partners, investors, and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Technology Transfer & Intellectual Property Management:

Lead and oversee the assessment, protection, and management of intellectual property, including inventions, software, data, and other research outputs;
Guide patenting and IP strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel;
Oversee the evaluation of invention disclosures for commercial potential and prioritize technologies for investment and advancement;
Lead negotiation and execution of license agreements, option agreements, NDAs, MTAs, and other IP-related contracts; and
Assist the Office of Sponsored Programs and University Counsel with intellectual property clauses in university agreements.

Technology Transfer Operations, Strategy & Team Leadership

Coordinate with the Associate Vice President to lead operational functions and new initiatives aligned with university strategy;
Recommend and implement streamlined procedures, systems, and best practices for technology transfer operations;
Manage staff and build a high-performing team to support invention intake, IP management, licensing, and industry engagement;
Maintain and enhance reporting, project management, and database systems related to commercialization activities;
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and outside counsel; and
Assist the Vice President of Research with George Mason Research Foundation operations.

Compliance, Policy & Stakeholder Communication

Ensure compliance with federal regulations, including Bayh–Dole requirements, conflict-of-interest policies, and reporting obligations;
Communicate technology transfer policies and processes to faculty in a manner that fosters understanding, trust, and collaboration; and
Prepare and present reports to university leadership as required.

Industry Partnerships & Commercialization Strategy

Serve as a liaison between faculty and industry partners to identify and align industry-relevant research opportunities;
Cultivate and manage relationships with corporations, startups, investors, venture capital firms, accelerators, and government agencies; and
Promote George Mason technologies through targeted outreach, meetings, presentations, and strategic partnerships.

Entrepreneurship & Innovation Ecosystem Development

Support faculty and student entrepreneurs in navigating commercialization pathways;
Collaborate with campus entrepreneurship programs, incubators, and economic development organizations; and
Provide strategic guidance to university-affiliated startups and help reduce barriers to startup formation and growth.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering, and business or law, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience;
Significant experience (generally at least 10 years) in technology transfer, intellectual property management, licensing, business development, or a related field within a research-intensive environment;
Generally, at least 5 years of proven leadership and people management skills;
Knowledge of technology transfer, intellectual property management, licensing, business development, or a related field within a research-intensive environment;
Demonstrated skill and success negotiating complex contracts and managing patent expenses;
Strong understanding/knowledge of the university research environment and ability to translate between academic research and industry needs;
Demonstrated team leadership and people management skills;
Ability to translate complex technical research into clear, non-confidential technology descriptions;
Demonstrated strategic thinking, sound judgment, and ability to work independently in a collaborative environment;
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
Strong organizational abilities;
Proficiency with MS Office and CRM or database systems; and
Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

Terminal degree such as a J.D., Ph.D., or MBA;
Background in computing, cybersecurity, bio-technology, engineering or other high-growth technology domains;
Significant experience in an academic technology transfer or commercialization office, particularly at an R1 institution;
Experience negotiating early-stage technology intellectual property and licensing agreements for businesses;
Experience with startup formation, early-stage venture financing, and entrepreneurial ecosystems;
Experience managing outside patent counsel and converting invention disclosures into strong provisional applications;
Established relationships with industry, investors, or sponsors involved in research or commercialization;
Experience implementing operational systems in a technology transfer or innovation office; and
Familiarity with AUTM practices and federal technology transfer regulations.

Instructions To Applicants

For full consideration, applicants must apply for the Senior Director, Technology Transfer
at https://jobs.gmu.edu/. Complete and submit the online application to include three professional references with contact information, and provide a cover letter and resume for review.

Posting Open Date:
August 24, 2026

September 7, 2026

Yes

Mason Ad Statement

George Mason University is a nationally ranked R1 research university committed to creating a more just, free, and prosperous world. With 40,000 enrolled students, George Mason is the largest and most diverse public research university in Virginia, offering degree programs at the master's, doctoral, and professional level, along with certificates and credentials.

George Mason fosters an All Together Different environment for students, faculty, and staff, driven by our core beliefs. We believe in inclusivity over exclusivity; we believe in advancing our mission by being willing to take risks, not avoiding them; and we believe our best work is possible when we apply our diversity of origin, identity, circumstance, and thought.

The Opportunity

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide.

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio.

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.

What You'll Do

Define and Implement Security Strategy

Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems.
Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Engineering, Platform, and Security leaders, helping drive innovation, customer trust, and business growth.
Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security.

Drive Systemic Risk Reduction

Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices.
Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation.
Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture.

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era

Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms.
Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences.
Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale.

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization

Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams.
Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Strengthen Customer Trust

Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle.
Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.
Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust.

What You'll Bring

Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies.
Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities.
Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.
Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services.

Leadership Characteristics

The successful candidate will:

Create the Future by enabling secure innovation and helping Adobe capitalize on emerging technologies.
Own the Outcome by driving meaningful improvements in security, trust, and organizational effectiveness.
Set a higher standard through technical excellence, operational rigor, and talent development.
Be Genuine by building trusted partnerships and leading with transparency and integrity.
